item.title: Week 10: Chargers at Ravens
item.description: Mon 11/16 · 8:15 PM ET | Line: BAL -4.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model BAL 88% vs. market 66% | On paper, Baltimore has the edge, with its defense 17th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.04 allowed) versus the Chargers' 32nd (-0.08), though the Chargers counter with a 12th-ranked red-zone defense (56% allowed) against Baltimore's 22nd-ranked 59% TD rate. Justin Herbert ranks 31st of 31 in EPA per dropback, with no Baltimore QB data to compare, and Mark Andrews (2.0 yards after catch below expected) meets a Chargers defense ranked 18th in YAC allowed over expected.
